title: 롤플레이 (11~13번)
intro: OPIc 11~13번은 한 상황이 질문하기(11번) → 문제 해결(12번) → 관련 경험(13번)으로 이어지는 롤플레이 구간입니다. 상대 대답 없이 혼자 말하므로 음성 메시지를 남기듯 한 번에 쭉 이어 말하면 됩니다. 상황은 늘 내 페르소나로 바꿔 생각하세요: 같은 과 친구 Minji와의 영화 약속, 가족 제주 여행, 작년 여름 오사카 여행처럼 이미 준비한 이야기를 그대로 재활용하면 훨씬 자연스럽습니다.
strategy: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장('Hi, I'm calling to ask about ~.') → 내 상황 한 줄(친구 Minji와 / 가족과) → 질문 3~4개 또는 문제 설명 + 대안 2개 → 마무리 문장('Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Thanks!')
11번(질문하기)은 First / Also / And one more thing 으로 질문을 3~4개 이상 이어 갑니다. 시간·가격·할인·좌석·포함 사항 중에서 고르세요.
12번(문제 해결)은 'I'm afraid there's a problem.' → 무슨 일이 생겼는지 한두 문장 → 'Is it possible to ~? / If not, could I ~?' 로 대안 2개 → 'Please call me back.' 으로 끝냅니다.
13번(경험)은 일반 경험 문제와 같습니다. 언제 → 무슨 일 → 내가 한 행동 → 결과·느낀 점을 과거시제로 말하고, 12번과 비슷한 소재(친구와의 약속, 여행 예약)를 고르면 준비가 쉽습니다.

expressions.en: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the movie this weekend.
expressions.ko: 안녕하세요, 이번 주말 영화 때문에 전화드렸어요.
expressions.note: 11번 만능 시작 문장. about 뒤만 바꾸기

expressions.en: How much is it for two people?
Do you have a student discount?
expressions.note: 대학생 페르소나라 어디서든 쓸 수 있는 질문

expressions.en: I'm afraid there's a problem with my booking.
Is it possible to change the date?
Please call me back when you get this message.
My friend just told me she can't make it.
If that's not possible, could I get a refund instead?
expressions.ko: 그게 안 되면 대신 환불받을 수 있을까요?

expressions.en: Is there anything else I should know?
expressions.ko: 제가 더 알아야 할 게 있을까요?
expressions.note: 질문 개수를 자연스럽게 하나 더 늘리는 문장

expressions.en: It was totally out of my control.
expressions.ko: 제가 어떻게 할 수 없는 일이었어요.

expressions.en: Luckily, it all worked out in the end.
I'd really appreciate it if you could help me out.
expressions.note: I'd appreciate it if ~ 공손한 부탁

expressions.en: Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Thanks so much!
expressions.ko: 네, 여쭤보고 싶은 건 이게 다예요. 정말 감사합니다!

questions.en: I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to see a movie with a friend this weekend. Call the movie theater and ask three or four questions about the movie.
questions.ko: 상황을 드릴 테니 연기해 보세요. 이번 주말에 친구와 영화를 보려고 합니다. 영화관에 전화해서 영화에 대해 질문 3~4개를 하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm calling to ask about ~.' → 친구 Minji와 볼 거라는 상황 한 줄 → 질문 3~4개(시간·가격·학생 할인·좌석) → 'Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask.'
질문마다 First / Also / And one more thing 을 붙이면 개수가 분명하게 들립니다.
IH 이상은 '제일 늦은 상영', '팝콘 세트'처럼 내 상황에 맞춘 질문을 하나 더 넣으세요.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the new action movie. My friend and I want to see it this Saturday, so I have a few questions. First, what time does it start on Saturday evening? Also, how much are the tickets for two people? We're both college students, so do you have a student discount? And one more thing, are there any good seats left in the middle? Okay, great. Thank you so much. Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Have a nice day!
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the new action movie that just came out. My friend Minji and I are planning to see it this Saturday, so I have a few questions. First of all, what time are the shows on Saturday? We have plans in the afternoon, so an evening show would be perfect for us. Also, how much are the tickets for two people? We're both college students, so I was wondering if you have a student discount. And are there any seats left in the middle? We don't really like sitting too close to the screen. Oh, and one more thing, do you have any popcorn and drink combos? Minji loves caramel popcorn, so I want to surprise her. Okay, that sounds great. Thank you so much for your help. Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Have a good one!
answers.AL: Hi there, I'm calling to ask about the new action movie that everyone's been talking about. My friend Minji and I have been dying to see it, and we finally found some free time this Saturday, so I have a few quick questions. First of all, what time are the evening shows on Saturday? We both have a group project meeting in the afternoon, so anything after six would be perfect. Also, how much are the tickets for two adults? We're both college students, so I was wondering if you offer any kind of student discount, and if so, do we just need to show our student IDs? Next, are there any good seats left in the middle? To be honest, we always end up with neck pain when we sit in the front row. And one more thing, do you have any popcorn and drink combos? Minji is crazy about caramel popcorn, so I'd like to grab a big one for her. Oh, and is it possible to book everything online, or should I just come to the ticket counter? Okay, that's really helpful. Thank you so much for your time. Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Have a great day!

questions.en: I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to go on a trip during your vacation. Call a travel agency and ask three or four questions about a trip package you are interested in.
questions.ko: 상황을 드릴 테니 연기해 보세요. 방학에 여행을 가려고 합니다. 여행사에 전화해서 관심 있는 여행 상품에 대해 질문 3~4개를 하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm calling about ~ package.' → 가족과 제주 여행을 계획 중이라는 상황 → 질문 3~4개(가격·일정·포함 사항·취소 규정) → 'Yeah, that's all I wanted to know.'
여행 상품 질문 단골: How long is the trip? / What's included? / Are flights and hotel included? / Can I cancel?
가족 4명(엄마·아빠·남동생 Junho·나)이라는 디테일을 넣으면 질문이 구체적으로 들립니다.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm calling about the Jeju Island package on your website. My family and I want to go there during my winter vacation. I have a few questions. First, how long is the trip? Also, how much is it for four people? Are the flights and the hotel included? And one more thing, can we rent a car there? My dad really wants to drive around the island. Okay, thank you so much. Yeah, that's all I wanted to know. Bye!
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling about the Jeju Island package I saw on your website. My family and I are planning a trip during my winter vacation, so I have a few questions. First of all, how long is the trip, and when are the departure dates in January? I still have some classes in December, so January would be better for me. Also, how much is it for four people? There are my parents, my younger brother, and me. Next, what's included in the price? I mean, are the flights, the hotel, and meals all included? And one more thing, is it possible to rent a car through you? My dad really wants to drive along the coast this time. Okay, that's really helpful. Could you send me the details by email? Thanks a lot. Yeah, that's all I wanted to know. Have a nice day!
answers.AL: Hi, I'm calling about the four-day Jeju Island package that I saw on your website. My family and I went to Jeju a few years ago and had an amazing time, so we're thinking of going back during my winter vacation. I have a few questions before we book anything. First of all, what dates are available in January? I'm a college student, and my finals don't end until the middle of December, so early January would be ideal. Also, how much would it be for four people? It's my parents, my younger brother Junho, and me, and Junho is still in high school, so I was wondering if there's any discount for students. Next, what exactly is included in the price? Are the flights, the hotel, and breakfast all included, or do we have to pay for some of those separately? And one more thing, could you also help us rent a car? My dad has been talking about driving along the coast for months, so that's kind of a must for us. Oh, and what's your cancellation policy, just in case something comes up? Okay, I really appreciate your help. Yeah, that's all I wanted to know for now. Thanks so much!

questions.en: I'm sorry, but there is a problem I need you to resolve. You bought two movie tickets for this weekend, but your friend just told you that she can't come. Call the theater, explain the situation, and suggest two or three alternatives.
questions.ko: 죄송하지만 해결해야 할 문제가 생겼습니다. 이번 주말 영화표를 두 장 샀는데 친구가 방금 못 온다고 했습니다. 영화관에 전화해 상황을 설명하고 대안을 2~3개 제시하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm afraid there's a problem with my tickets.' → Minji가 못 오게 된 이유 한두 문장 → 대안 2개(다른 날로 변경 / 한 장 환불) → 'Please call me back.'
대안은 'Is it possible to ~? / If not, could I ~?' 두 틀만 외워도 충분합니다.
예매 정보(토요일 저녁 7시, 두 장)를 말해 주면 실제 통화처럼 들립니다.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm afraid there's a problem with my tickets. I bought two tickets for the action movie this Saturday at seven. But my friend just told me she can't come. She has to visit her grandmother. So, is it possible to change the tickets to next Saturday? If not, could I get a refund for one ticket? Please let me know. My number is on the booking. Yeah, that's it. Thank you, and please call me back.
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling because I'm afraid there's a problem with my tickets. I booked two tickets for the new action movie this Saturday at seven p.m. But my friend Minji just texted me and said she can't make it. Her grandmother is sick, so she has to go to her hometown this weekend. I really don't want to go alone, so I have a couple of ideas. First, is it possible to change both tickets to next Saturday at the same time? We're both free then. If that's not possible, could I get a refund for just one ticket? Then I might go with my younger brother instead. I know it's last minute, so I'd really appreciate your help. My name and phone number are on the booking. Yeah, that's about it. Please call me back when you get this message. Thank you!
answers.AL: Hi, this is a call about my booking, and I'm afraid there's a bit of a problem. I booked two tickets for the new action movie this Saturday at seven p.m., and we even picked seats right in the middle. But my friend Minji just called me, and she said she can't make it after all. Her grandmother suddenly got sick, so she has to go back to her hometown this weekend, which was totally out of her control. Honestly, I don't really feel like watching it alone, so I was hoping we could work something out. First, is it possible to move both tickets to next Saturday at the same time? Minji said she's free then, and we'd really like to watch it together. If that doesn't work, could I just get a refund for one of the tickets? In that case, I'll probably drag my younger brother along instead, since he's been wanting to see it too. And if neither of those works, I'd be happy to get a voucher for another movie. I know this is pretty last minute, so I'd really appreciate it if you could help me out. My phone number is on the booking. Yeah, that's pretty much it. Please call me back when you get a chance. Thanks so much!

questions.en: I'm sorry, but there is a problem I need you to resolve. You booked a trip through a travel agency, but you just found out that your flight has been canceled. Call the travel agency, explain the situation, and suggest two or three alternatives.
questions.ko: 죄송하지만 해결해야 할 문제가 생겼습니다. 여행사를 통해 여행을 예약했는데 방금 항공편이 취소됐다는 걸 알았습니다. 여행사에 전화해 상황을 설명하고 대안을 2~3개 제시하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm afraid there's a problem with my trip.' → 가족 제주 여행 항공편이 취소된 상황 → 대안 2개(다음 날 항공편 / 전체 일정 연기 또는 환불) → 'Please call me back.'
취소 이유는 'because of the bad weather' 처럼 짧게 말하면 충분합니다.
호텔·렌터카도 함께 바꿔 달라고 하면 IH 이상의 구체성이 생깁니다.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm afraid there's a problem with my trip. I booked the Jeju package for my family. We're leaving this Friday morning. But I just got a message that our flight was canceled because of the weather. So, is it possible to get seats on a flight on Saturday? If not, could we move the whole trip to next week? Please let me know soon. Yeah, that's all. Please call me back. Thank you.
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling about my Jeju trip, and I'm afraid there's a problem. I booked the four-day package for my family, and we're supposed to leave this Friday morning. But I just got a text from the airline saying that our flight has been canceled because of a big storm. We were really looking forward to this trip, so I'd like to fix it if possible. First, could you find us four seats on another flight on Friday afternoon or Saturday morning? If we leave on Saturday, we'll just need to change the hotel by one night. If that's not possible, could we move the whole trip to next week? My dad already took time off work, so we'd really like to go soon. Please check and let me know. Yeah, that's it. Please call me back as soon as you can. Thanks a lot!
answers.AL: Hi, I'm calling about the Jeju package I booked through you, and I'm afraid there's a pretty big problem. It's a four-day trip for my family of four, and we're supposed to fly out this Friday morning. But about an hour ago, I got a text from the airline saying our flight has been canceled because of a typhoon. It's totally out of anyone's control, I get that, but we've been planning this trip for months, so I really want to find a way to make it work. First, could you check if there are four seats on any later flight, maybe Friday night or early Saturday morning? If we leave on Saturday, we'd only need to push the hotel and the rental car back by one day, so it shouldn't be too complicated. If that's not possible, could we move the whole trip to the following weekend? My dad would have to change his vacation days, but I think he can manage. And if neither of those options works out, I'd like to ask for a full refund, since the cancellation wasn't our fault. I'd really appreciate it if you could look into this as soon as possible. Yeah, that's pretty much the situation. Please call me back when you get this. Thank you!

questions.en: That's the end of the situation. Have you ever had a plan canceled or changed at the last minute? Tell me what happened and how you handled it.
questions.ko: 상황은 끝났습니다. 계획이 마지막 순간에 취소되거나 바뀐 적이 있나요? 무슨 일이 있었고 어떻게 대처했는지 말해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Oh, last-minute changes? Let me think.' → 언제·누구와(Minji와 부산 여행) → 무슨 일(태풍) → 내가 한 일 → 결과·느낀 점 → 'Yeah, that's ~.'
과거시제를 끝까지 유지하세요. 'We were supposed to ~' 는 '원래 ~하기로 했다'는 뜻으로 아주 유용합니다.
결론은 'In the end, it all worked out.' 처럼 긍정적으로 마무리하면 깔끔합니다.

answers.IM3: Oh, a plan that changed at the last minute? Let me think. Last summer, my friend Minji and I planned a trip to Busan. We booked the train and a small hotel near Haeundae Beach. But the day before the trip, a typhoon came. So we called the hotel and moved everything to the next weekend. I was really sad at first. But the next weekend, the weather was perfect. Yeah, that's my story about a changed plan.
answers.IH: Oh, a plan that got changed at the last minute? Let me think. Actually, it happened last summer. My friend Minji and I were supposed to go to Busan for two days. We booked the KTX train and a small hotel near Haeundae Beach, and we even made a list of places to eat. But the night before we left, the news said a big typhoon was coming. We were so disappointed, but going there would be too dangerous. So I called the hotel and explained the situation, and luckily they let us change the dates for free. Minji changed the train tickets online. One week later, we finally went, and the weather was sunny and perfect. We swam at the beach and ate pork soup every day. Yeah, that's how I handled my last-minute change.
answers.AL: Oh, a last-minute change? Let me think. Actually, I had a pretty memorable one last summer. My friend Minji and I had been planning a trip to Busan for weeks. We booked KTX tickets and a cute little hotel near Haeundae Beach, and we even made a list of all the restaurants we wanted to try, especially the famous pork soup places. But the night before we were supposed to leave, I was packing my bag when Minji called me in a panic. She said the news was reporting that a huge typhoon was heading straight for Busan. At first, I honestly didn't want to believe it, because we'd been looking forward to it so much. But we both knew it would be too risky to go. So the next morning, I called the hotel, explained the situation, and asked if we could change our dates. Luckily, the staff were really understanding and moved our booking to the next weekend for free. Minji took care of the train tickets online. One week later, we finally went, and the weather couldn't have been better. Looking back, that delay actually made the trip feel even more special. Yeah, that's how I dealt with a last-minute change.

questions.en: That's the end of the situation. Have you ever had a problem with a ticket, a reservation, or something you bought? Tell me what the problem was and how you solved it.
questions.ko: 상황은 끝났습니다. 표나 예약, 또는 구입한 물건에 문제가 생긴 적이 있나요? 어떤 문제였고 어떻게 해결했는지 말해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Oh, a problem with a ticket? Let me tell you about ~.' → 언제·어디서(작년 여름 오사카, 유니버설 스튜디오) → 문제(날짜를 잘못 예매) → 해결 과정 → 결과·배운 점 → 'Yeah, that's ~.'
문제 원인이 나의 실수라면 'It was my mistake.' 라고 솔직하게 말하는 것도 자연스럽습니다.
IH 이상은 배운 점(이제는 항상 두 번 확인한다)을 한 문장 덧붙이세요.

answers.IM3: Oh, a problem with a ticket? Let me tell you about one. Last summer, I went to Osaka with my family. I bought tickets for Universal Studios online. But at the gate, the staff said our tickets were for the next day. It was my mistake! I talked to the staff at the ticket office. They were really kind and changed the date for us. So we got in. Now I always check the date twice. Yeah, that's my ticket story.
answers.IH: Oh, a problem with a ticket? Let me tell you about one. Last summer, my family and I took a trip to Osaka, Japan. I was in charge of buying the Universal Studios tickets, so I bought four of them online a few weeks before the trip. But when we got to the gate, the staff told us our tickets were for the next day. I was so embarrassed, because it was totally my mistake. My younger brother kept teasing me about it. Anyway, we went to the ticket office, and I explained the situation in simple English. Luckily, the staff were really nice. They said the park wasn't too crowded that day, so they changed the date for us. We only had to pay a small fee. After that, we had a great day. Since then, I always check the date twice. Yeah, that's how I solved my ticket problem.
answers.AL: Oh, a problem with a ticket? Let me tell you about a pretty embarrassing one. Last summer, my family and I went on a trip to Osaka, and I volunteered to take care of the Universal Studios tickets, since I'm the one who's best at booking things online. A few weeks before the trip, I bought four tickets, and I was honestly kind of proud of myself for getting a good deal. But when we finally got to the gate, all excited, the staff scanned our tickets and told us they were for the next day. My heart just sank. It turned out I'd clicked the wrong date on the calendar, so it was totally my fault. My younger brother Junho wouldn't stop teasing me, and my dad just laughed. Anyway, I took a deep breath, went to the ticket office, and explained the situation in my best English. Luckily, the staff were super understanding. Since the park wasn't too crowded that day, they changed the date for us for just a small fee. In the end, we had an amazing day, and the whole thing became a family joke. Ever since then, I always double-check the date before I pay. Yeah, that's my little ticket disaster.
